collection.title: BMW 1 Series Hatchback 2004 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 1 Series Hatchback 2004 to 2011 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this 1 Series Hatchback which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
